No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this visit you examine craft processes, attribution and curation.

The gallery, date, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Museum orientation
  • Object/craft reading
  • Demonstration if active
  • Museum ethics

How the time is spent

  1. Museum orientation 20 min

    Discuss vernacular techniques and collecting.

    You: collection map

  2. Object/craft reading 55 min

    Material, function, region and change.

    You: object log

  3. Demonstration if active 45 min

    Listen to craft practitioner as available.

    You: process notes

  4. Museum ethics 30 min

    Discuss living practice vs static display.

    You: reflection

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

You take away

A portfolio of your work from each session.
